up: Retrieve up to 1000 activity rows for the human single-protein target CHEMBL2345 (Ribosomal protein S6 kinase alpha-3) where the standard_type is IC50. Return exactly these columns: assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, and pchembl_value. Apply filters for exact standard relation ('='), non-null pchembl_value, and standard_type = 'IC50'. Order the results by molecule_chembl_id ascending, then assay_chembl_id ascending. Limit to 1000 rows.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  a.assay_chembl_id,
  tt.target_type,
  td.tax_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  md.molecule_chembl_id,
  a.standard_type,
  a.pchembl_value
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN target_type tt ON td.target_type = tt.target_type
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molecule_chembl_id = md.molecule_chembl_id
JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molecule_chembl_id = cs.molecule_chembl_id
WHERE
  td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBBL2345'
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.standard_relation = '='
  AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
  md.molecule_chembl_id ASC,
  a.assay_chembl_id ASC
LIMIT 1000
